info.syllabusName: Advanced Presentation Skills_Kỹ năng thuyết trình nâng cao
info.timeAllocation: 58 hours online study + 3 hrs offline (2 slots) + PE (5 mins/student) + 89 hours self-study
info.studentTasks:
1. Join the online course (spec.) when being invited by the admin.

2. Enroll in each MOOC of spec., regularly study MOOCs at least 5hrs/week by watching videos, reading materials, taking quizzes, doing assgnments... as required

3. Respect the Coursera Code of Conduct, at https://learner.coursera.help/hc/en-us/articles/208280036-Coursera-Code-of-Conduct

3. Keep online learning progress promptly (bonus will be awarded)

4. Communicate and discuss in forum

5. Attend off-line sessions in the Campus (Optional)

6. Must complete all MOOCs of spec. with certification in order to take the Final Exam at Campus
info.note:
1) Ongoing assessment: Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded.

2) Theoretical Exam (PE)

3) Final Result (FR) =min (10, PE + Bonus)

4) Completion Criteria: PE>=4 and FR>=5

assessments.gradingGuide:
Deliver a speech of 4-5 minutes long. Students could choose an option from the list:

- informative speeches

- persuasive speeches

- inspirational speeches

Students present the speech they have done for the online assignments. However, students need to edit content and other details to meet the requirements of the PE.
